data.title: 史黛菈 · 王宫露台的法米利昂皇家礼服
data.description: 法米利昂王宫高耸的观景露台上，夜空漫天星斗。史黛菈身穿一袭奢华尊贵的深红露肩皇家晚礼服，华丽的金色刺绣在烛台光芒下流光溢彩。火红的长双马尾在晚风中狂舞，衬托出傲视天下的皇女威严与天生丽质的娇媚。她单手按在胸口，红眸灼灼生辉，向你倾吐着作为皇女与恋人的无上忠贞。
data.action: standing at palace balcony railing in royal crimson off-shoulder gown with gold embroidery, ruby twintails billowing in night wind, proud yet passionately tender gaze at viewer
data.location: magnificent royal palace balcony overlooking illuminated kingdom under stars
data.lighting: rich golden candelabra glow paired with dramatic starry night sky
data.mood: proud royal majesty, passionate imperial devotion
data.promptProse: Standing on a grand palace balcony under starry skies, Stella Vermillion wears a lavish crimson royal gown with gold embroidery. The night wind whips her long red twintails as she looks forward with proud, passionate devotion.
data.animaCaption: Stella standing on a royal balcony under the stars in an opulent crimson gown.
